title: Fleet Service Log
oneLiner: Phone web vehicle maintenance log and daily inspection checklist for small fleets (5 to 50 vans or trucks), with full service history and a shareable driver link
customer: Owners and office managers of small US service fleets (plumbers, landscapers, HVAC, delivery) with 5 to 50 vehicles
revenueModel: Free single-vehicle log; paid monthly tier for many vehicles, driver links, reminders and full history export

paidPrice.product: Fleetio Essential at USD 5 a vehicle a month billed monthly (no free plan); a 10 vehicle fleet pays USD 50, about Rs 4,714 at 94.2754 INR per USD

searches.note: DataForSEO Google Ads search volume, United States, via Firecrawl Alexandria, 21 Nov 2026. fleet maintenance software alone clears 1,000 with CPC USD 158, so buyers pay.

screen.freeGap: The only free plan found, Simply Fleet Free, needs an account and stops at 5 vehicles, 3 users and 6 months of stored data (https://www.simplyfleet.app/pricing); Fleetio has a trial only. Fleetio free tools are downloadable spreadsheets (https://www.fleetio.com/tools), not a saved, shareable log. Gap: a no-account phone log that keeps full service history and gives drivers an inspection link. Risk: no-account alone is not a reason to pay (golf-league precedent); the paid tier must sell history, many vehicles and driver links.

evidence.claim: A UK landscaping business with 8 cars and vans asked Reddit for a simple tool to track service, maintenance, mileage and running costs, saying every fleet platform found was aimed at much bigger businesses with full time fleet managers (post 7 Apr 2026, 31 comments).

Etsy sells paid fleet maintenance trackers, including a Vehicle Fleet Maintenance Tracker Excel spreadsheet at USD 29.95 with 54 reviews (4.7) and a Fleet Maintenance Tracker sheet for up to 300 vans at USD 17.99 with 15 reviews (5.0).
Simply Fleet charges USD 3 a vehicle a month (Essential) or USD 5 (Advanced) with a 5 vehicle minimum, and its free plan stops at 5 vehicles, 3 users and 6 months of data history.
Fleetio charges USD 5 a vehicle a month billed monthly for Essential (USD 4 annually), up to USD 10 for Premium, with no free plan, only a 14 day trial.

nextAction: Research writes the business case; sizing sizes it; CEO decides. Evidence against: replies in the Reddit thread steer small fleets to a free spreadsheet or a my-garage app, and the asker settled on a manual solution; LubeLogger is a free open source self-hosted log with many vehicles, service records and reminders (https://lubelogger.com/); Fleetio gives free spreadsheet templates (https://www.fleetio.com/tools); Etsy templates cost USD 2 to 30 once, so the paid tier must beat a one-off sheet on driver links, reminders and history.

lead.name: Arnav
lead.trait: Quick to test, quicker to kill what does not work.
